notes.title: Garage racing track is in the works!
notes.content:
[b]Hello Drivers,[/b]

At the time we write this message, we create a new track for [b]Mini Wheels[/b]. It will be based in the garage of [b]Mick's house[/b], and here you can see first arts we made before we started to plan all the hops and turns:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31795462/7df5bc3dde731f477c1121c7960620abbaad7a6c.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31795462/b1fc1f673d0b882a0f4e432f06e501de4f881dc1.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31795462/e6519cda832ff3f66b35a01150248c6ea076a55e.jpg[/img]

We see it as a shadowy place with loads of equipment of all sort. As the light source, we plan to use the glow sticks, which could build a deep atmosphere. That's not the final version though, so we are waiting for your comments. What do you think we should look at when designing a racing track in this peculiar place? Are there any specific items you think we should include?

[b]Take care,[/b]
[i]Enigma Studios[/i]
